thread:
anya: quick heads-up — proposing a short calibration + rollout plan for Marlin-12B; want a concise decision path and checklist we can use this sprint.

matt: +1. keep it short so SRE can scope mem/latency impact.

anya: TL;DR: go hybrid. primary artifact: gguf-int8 with selective fp8 on sensitive layers (attn.q + mlp.fc2) if sensitivity warrants. fallback: fp16 runtime.
- target cost: ~2.5x-3x savings vs fp16
- quality: regression <=1.5% EM/F1 or <=2.5 ppl on eval slices
- rollout: canary -> shadow -> ramp

shivani: calibration dataset? full eval or small calib corpus?

anya: propose ~6k tokens sampled: 40% generation (summ/instruct), 35% QA, 25% dialogue. stratify by length. calib set separate from final eval.

blake: runtime note: int8 uses per-channel scales; fp8 needs distinct kernels and ~1.05-1.15x act memory while compiling. need peak activation estimate to pick batch sizes.

liam: add gating thresholds so ops can automate alerts/rollbacks.

anya: gating proposal:
- automated smoke: 500 prompts from calib; fail if mean EM/F1 drop >1.5% OR median PPL delta >2.5
- human review: any safety/hallucination flags from QA block rollout
- perf gate: p99 latency increase <=10% vs fp16 baseline on same infra; else reduce batch or fallback

matt: which eval harness/sha?

anya: eval-harness v3.4 + metrics plugin. example run:

```
./run_eval.sh --model marlin-12b --weights /mnt/staging/marlin/gguf_int8_hybrid --evalsets qa_synth,news_summ,dialogue_small --metrics em,f1,ppl,rouge
```

shivani: reuse calibrator script from Luna run with different seeds.

```
./calib_run.sh \
  --model marlin-12b \
  --mode hybrid-int8-fp8 \
  --calib-file s3://redwood-calib/marlin/calib_v1.jsonl \
  --batch 4 \
  --steps 1200 \
  --export /tmp/marlin_hybrid.gguf
```

calib-bot: simulated summary: steps=1200, calib_tokens=6.4k, top-sensitive layers: attn.q_proj, mlp.fc2, attn.o_proj. suggested: fp8 for attn.q_proj + mlp.fc2; int8 elsewhere. est mem saving vs fp16: 2.7x.

liam: ok that aligns with heuristics. infra smoke checklist (compact):
- build gguf artifact + checksum
- upload to staging + manifest
- deploy canary (1 pod) on dedicated pool
- run smoke eval (500 prompts) + perf probe (batch 1..8)
- collect p50/p95/p99 + GPU mem and kv cache stats
- if pass -> shadow (10% traffic) for 24h
- run daily regression for 3 days before wider promotion

blake: add: verify fp8 CUDA kernels present and explicit fallback behavior; no silent fp16 fallbacks.

shivani: human-signal: sample 50 outputs per task type, double rater, accept/reject threshold >=90% accept.

matt: timeline estimate?

anya: conservative:
- day 0: calibration runs + artifact bake
- day 1: canary + smoke
- day 2-3: shadow + 24h monitor
- day 7: GA if clean

liam: logging/trace hooks: include per-request: model_variant, quant_mode, tokens_in/out, kv_cache_hit, p99_latency_ms, sample_eval_metrics if smoke.

blake: ensure model signature embeds quant metadata (per-layer scales, ranges) so runtime can validate.

shivani: i'll convert to short runbook PR and attach calib dataset + gating thresholds + small human eval form.

anya: starting calibration tonight. will post artifacts to staging when ready. :thumbsup:

calib-bot: scheduled job: marlin-12b hybrid calibration queued (job id 9347). ETA ~2.5h.

matt: keep thread updated with calib-bot output. thanks.
